title: tilia sylvestris subsp. intermedia
intro: Tilia sylvestris subsp. intermedia, commonly known as Silver Lime or Small-leaved Lime, is a subspecies of the Small-leaved Lime tree, native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for centuries, with its leaves offering several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of colds, fever, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Tilia sylvestris subsp. intermedia include calming and sedative effects, making it useful in treating anxiety, insomnia, and restlessness, as well as exhibiting a mild expectorant action to ease coughs and congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, such as linalool and limonene, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
